credits: ntrrptr — MIDI Loopback design and code

presentation.label: MIDI Loopback
presentation.summary: MIDI tracks 9–16 play and modulate the Digitakt's own audio tracks and Master FX inside the box: CCs, locks, notes and the MIDI LFO, no cable.
presentation.overview: MIDI Loopback, by ntrrptr, is a MIDI cable inside the Digitakt. Turn it on in SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK, set a MIDI track's channel to an audio track's channel, and that MIDI track's CC knobs, parameter locks, notes and LFO control the audio track: filter, tune, sample start and length, overdrive, envelope and sends, with notes playing it chromatically. A MIDI track on the FX control channel reaches the delay, reverb, compressor and external mixer, and one on the auto channel reaches whichever track is active. Messages on channels no internal track uses still go out of MIDI OUT and USB. It is off until you turn it on, and it names the Digitakt's parameters on the MIDI tracks' CC Select page.
highlights: A MIDI track on an audio track's channel modulates it with CCs, locks and its LFO, a third LFO for that track.
Notes on that MIDI track play the audio track chromatically, chords included.
The FX control channel reaches the delay, reverb, compressor and external mixer.
Off by default; channels no internal track uses still go out of MIDI OUT and USB.
usage: In SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK press YES to turn it on.
On MIDI track 9 set CHAN on the SRC page to audio track 1's channel (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS).
On that MIDI track's AMP page (CC Select) set SEL1 to 74, shown as FLT FREQ, then turn VAL1 on the FLTR page (CC Value): track 1's filter moves.
Lock VAL1 on a few steps and play the pattern; turn MIDI LOOPBACK off again to send everything out of MIDI OUT as before.

access.location: SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK, then any MIDI track
steps: Use a build containing MIDI Loopback for the original Digitakt on OS 1.53 or 1.54.
In SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK press YES to turn it on.
Set a MIDI track's channel to an audio track's channel, then use its CC page, locks and LFO.

controls.name: SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK
controls.doc: YES toggles it, RIGHT turns it on, LEFT off. Off is the stock behaviour: messages go to MIDI OUT and USB.

controls.name: SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS
controls.doc: The channels of audio tracks 1–8, the auto channel and the FX control channel, which a MIDI track's CHAN can name.

controls.name: MIDI track SRC > CHAN
controls.doc: An internal channel routes that MIDI track into the Digitakt; any other channel goes out as usual.

limitations: Off by default. While it is on, messages on channels assigned to internal tracks stay inside and do not leave by MIDI OUT or USB.
Not with FX Track or MIDI Expression: they patch the same MIDI code.
Needs core 4.1 or newer, so it does not build beside Digi EQ 1.0.2, which builds only on core 2.1.

load.display: A short flush at the end of each audio render; empty while MIDI LOOPBACK is off
load.conditions: From the source: ev_render_out moves the queued loopback messages into the internal MIDI input (a 128-message ring); its other code runs on the MIDI and UI side. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author reports testing MIDI Loopback 1.6 on their Digitakt mk1, the version they use (release v1.6, 18 November 2026). This module pins those released files for OS 1.53 and 1.54.
limitations: The author's report gives no OS release, date or duration: testedOn is the v1.6 release date, and the release names 1.54 among the OS files it was built for.
Not tested with Modwerk's library mods.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 1.6 files, pinned unchanged, linked locally with core 4.4 beside every Digitakt mod in the library: on OS 1.53 it builds beside all of them; on OS 1.54 beside all but FX Track and MIDI Expression (the same MIDI code). Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk. Beside CC Names, both showed their labels in the emulator: CC Names on CC Value, MIDI Loopback on CC Select.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: drive an audio track's filter from a MIDI track
steps: In SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK press YES to turn it on.
On MIDI track 9 set CHAN on the SRC page to audio track 1's channel (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS).
On that MIDI track's AMP page (CC Select) set SEL1 to 74, shown as FLT FREQ, then turn VAL1 on the FLTR page (CC Value): track 1's filter moves.
Lock VAL1 on a few steps and play the pattern; turn MIDI LOOPBACK off again to send everything out of MIDI OUT as before.
